map.依据井下同时作业人数、柴油设备功率、一次爆破炸药量与瓦斯涌出量，分别按四种方法计: Computes the required airflow by four methods from the number of people working underground, diesel equipment power, the explosive quantity per blast and the gas emission rate, takes the maximum and multiplies it by the leakage factor to give the design airflow.
map.💡 按人数 Q₁=4N；按柴油设备 Q₂=4P；按炸药量 Q₃=25A；按瓦斯: 💡 By headcount Q₁=4N; by diesel equipment Q₂=4P; by explosive quantity Q₃=25A; by gas Q₄=100q/C; design airflow = max(Q₁,Q₂,Q₃,Q₄) × leakage factor.
map.📊 计算方法与单位风量参考: 📊 Calculation Methods and Unit Airflow Reference
map.按人数：每人 4 m³/min（《煤矿安全规程》井下人员需风量）: By headcount: 4 m³/min per person (required airflow for underground personnel in the Coal Mine Safety Regulations)
map.按柴油设备：每 kW 功率 4 m³/min: By diesel equipment: 4 m³/min per kW of power
map.按炸药量：每 kg 炸药 25 m³/min（爆破后稀释有毒气体经验值）: By explosive quantity: 25 m³/min per kg of explosive (empirical value for diluting toxic gas after blasting)
map.按瓦斯涌出量：Q = 100q/C，C 为允许浓度（%，CH₄ 取 1%）: By gas emission rate: Q = 100q/C, where C is the allowable concentration (%, CH₄ taken as 1%)
map.公式为通用经验值，实际需结合矿井瓦斯等级、巷道断面与通风方式核定: The formulas are general empirical values; in practice they must be verified against the mine gas classification, roadway cross-section and ventilation mode
map.设计风量应满足所有方法的最大值，并留有漏风余量: The design airflow must satisfy the maximum of all methods and leave leakage margin
map.📚 深度解析：矿井通风量计算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Mine Ventilation Airflow Calculator
map.按矿山安全规程多准则并行计算需风量：人数、柴油设备、炸药量、瓦斯涌出，取最大者为: Compute required airflow with parallel criteria per the mine safety regulations: headcount, diesel equipment, explosive quantity and gas emission, taking the maximum as the controlling item.
map.设计阶段做风量比选：调整漏风系数 k，看设计风量（m³/min 与 m³/s）变: Airflow comparison at the design stage: adjust the leakage factor k and watch how the design airflow (m³/min and m³/s) changes, reserving fan margin.
map.通风系统复核：实测瓦斯涌出量变化后回算控制项是否仍是瓦斯项，判断风机能力是否足够: Ventilation system review: after measured gas emission changes, back-calculate whether the gas item is still the controlling item and judge whether the fan capacity is sufficient.
map.四类需风量：按人数 Q1=4N；按柴油设备 Q2=4P（P 总功率 kW）；按炸: Four required airflows: by headcount Q1=4N; by diesel equipment Q2=4P (P total power in kW); by explosive quantity Q3=25A (A explosive per blast in kg); by gas Q4=100q/C (q emission in m³/min, C allowable concentration in %). Controlling item=max(Q1..Q4); design airflow=controlling item×leakage factor k; design airflow (m³/s)=design airflow/60.
map.井下 30 人、柴油设备 120 kW、一次爆破 50 kg、瓦斯涌出 3 m³: Underground 30 people, diesel equipment 120 kW, 50 kg per blast, gas emission 3 m³/min, allowable concentration 1%, leakage factor 1.2. Q1=120, Q2=480, Q3=1250, Q4=300; controlling item Q3=1250 m³/min (by explosive quantity), design airflow=1250×1.2=1500 m³/min=25.00 m³/s.
map.当瓦斯涌出 q 增大到 q=100×C 附近，Q4 会逼近并超过 Q3。例如 q: When the gas emission q grows to around q=100×C, Q4 approaches and exceeds Q3. For example with q=15 and C=1, Q4=1500>Q3 and the controlling item switches to the gas item. Design should be based on the most adverse condition (maximum explosive quantity or maximum gas emission) and ensure the fan still has margin under the controlling condition.
map.为什么四个准则取最大值？: Why take the maximum of the four criteria?
map.矿井需风量必须同时满足所有有害物稀释与人员供氧要求，任一项不足都会成为安全瓶颈，: Required airflow must simultaneously satisfy dilution of all contaminants and oxygen supply for people; any insufficient item becomes a safety bottleneck, so the maximum across criteria becomes the controlling item (the weakest link of the barrel). This is the parallel checking approach required by the regulations, not a weighted average.
map.漏风系数 1.2 什么意思？: What does a leakage factor of 1.2 mean?
map.漏风系数 k 是考虑井巷漏风后，风机供给风量相对作业点有效风量的放大倍数（k≥1: The leakage factor k is the multiplier by which the fan must supply more than the effective airflow at the working point to offset leakage in roadways (k≥1). k=1.2 means the fan must supply 20% more air to offset losses. With long roadways, many air doors and poor sealing, k is larger, and design should use measured or empirical values.
map.用于矿井通风设计需风量估算。按井下作业人数、柴油设备功率、一次爆破炸药量与瓦斯涌: Used to estimate required airflow for mine ventilation design. The required airflow is computed by four methods from underground headcount, diesel equipment power, explosive quantity per blast and gas emission rate, and the maximum is multiplied by the leakage factor to give the design ventilation airflow (m³/min and m³/s).
map.支持漏风系数与瓦斯允许浓度自定义: Supports custom leakage factor and allowable gas concentration
